perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Air Assault
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.desc: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
